Section 1 amends section 2(d) of Executive Order 12401 so that the Commission submits its final report to the President and the Secretary of the Interior by November 30, 1984. Under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (report deadlines, option C) a report deadline is not an end: the command is functionally spent when the Commission reports, but the order remained on the books until this revocation. Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12442, whose subject line describes continuing the President’s Commission on Indian Reservation Economies. Section 2 amends section 4(b) of Executive Order 12401 so that the Commission, unless sooner extended, terminates 30 days after it transmits its final report to the President. This is a report-relative sunset: its date depends on the date the final report was transmitted, which is not held in this packet’s citable evidence, and it is treated as functionally spent on that date and not as the end, by analogy to owner ruling 2026-10-21 (report deadlines, option C), which that ruling applies to report-relative sunsets; this analogy is a reading disclosed for the reviewer. Executive Order 12534 of September 30, 1985 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) revokes the parent order 12401 but does not name this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) it is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event. No earlier express end was found.

It amends the report date and termination date of the Presidential Commission on Indian Reservation Economies. Inventory: two numbered sections, each recorded as one clause and confirmed against the full held text. Ending: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12442, whose subject line describes continuing the President’s Commission on Indian Reservation Economies. Neither section has a fixed calendar sunset of its own: the first is a report deadline and the second a report-relative termination.  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found no held text citing this order by number other than its own printings.
